_about: PROPOSED, CONFIGURABLE escalation-eligibility rules for the research prototype (Agent 3). These are NOT official rules of the Saudi Digital Government Authority (DGA) or of the AMER / Balaagh Digital service. Replace them only with rules supported by verified official documentation. The prototype only SIMULATES escalation; it never submits anything to a government system.
default_sla_note: Default SLA (days) is a placeholder used only when a complaint record has no SLA of its own. Replace it with the service provider's published SLA if available.

rules.description: A previous complaint about the same problem was submitted to the service provider first (a reference that can be verified exists).
The previous complaint is still unresolved, or was closed without resolution.
The applicable SLA response deadline for that complaint has passed.
The current issue severity is at or above the configured minimum (default: High).
A human officer approves before any external escalation (always mandatory).
